## [1.1.0-dev.2](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/compare/v1.1.0-dev.1...v1.1.0-dev.2) (2026-08-19)

### ✨ New Features

* add 365Scores, Livescore, IPTV, and FishBuddy patches ([d62d2d3](https://github.com/heval99/Heval-Morphe-Patches/commit/d62d2d3623991b53323399708321a7e8ee24982f))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Prevents AppLovin interstitial ads from loading and showing.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics event logging.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features by bypassing RevenueCat subscription checks.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features by patching the Java license wrapper methods in JniAdExt: isFreeLicense returns false (app treats the license as paid), account registration and address book are allowed, and the remove-license option is available in settings. Note: the underlying license validation is native (libanydesk.so) and cannot be patched via bytecode — this patch only affects the Java-layer feature gates.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables feature toggle controls.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Forces AdsRemovalSettings.areAdsDisabled() to return true, disabling banner, interstitial, MPU, hero placement, coverage sponsorship and announcement ads.

patches.name: Enable FotMob+
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Enable Premium+
patches.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization, blocking banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.

patches.name: Block marketing notifications
patches.description: Blocks promotional and marketing notification prompts and modals.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables banner, interstitial, feed, native, preroll and rewarded ads.

patches.name: Disable Facebook SDK
patches.description: Disables Facebook SDK initialization, marketing, and ad network activity.

patches.name: Disable Play Integrity
patches.description: Bypasses Google Play Integrity API checks.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Adjust telemetry.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks AI insights and premium features locked behind subscription.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Braze custom event tracking. Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics are covered by the universal "Disable Firebase Analytics & Crashlytics" patch.

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all features locked behind the Saphe subscription paywall (navigation, car integration, speed limits, voice alarms, roadwork detection, animal nearby, slow-moving traffic, emergency vehicle, etc.).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Forces User.hasPremium() to return true, unlocking premium features locked behind the RevenueCat subscription entitlement.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Wortise ad SDK initialization, blocking banner, interstitial, native and mediated ads (AppLovin, Yandex, Google Mobile Ads, etc.).

patches.name: Enable Premium
patches.description: Forces IptvFreeApplication's pro/trial gate to return true, keeping pro features unlocked after the 20-minute trial expires and suppressing the in-app review / buy-pro upsell prompts.
